headline: Will the War Resume Before the Midterms? Latest Odds
status: A Panama-flagged tanker, the On Peace, was hit by an unknown projectile in Hormuz, wounding 12 crew; no one claimed it. Qatar says US–Iran messages are still moving through Doha. Trump says the US must finish with Iran "the nice way or the not-so-nice way." Houthis claimed strikes on Riyadh's airport and the Rabigh refinery; the East-West line is moving oil to Yanbu. Brent dipped below $100.
change_note: Since Oct. 5: no change. No IRGC-claimed hit and no new Saudi- or UAE-linked ship struck. War by Nov. 3 holds at 60%.

bets.cond: The IRGC claims a hit, lays mines or strikes infrastructure
Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
A strike hits the Fujairah/Sohar transfer zone, or the East-West line is offline for days
